[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38391122/e6e342dedc7207aa0f781137a34a9ac46a535a97.png[/img]

GAMER Plan is a new brand that will focus on releasing interesting and fun all-ages games!

[h1]GAMER Plan's the first project:
"Rasetsu Fumaden" is now on sale![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844400/_/

This is an action RPG set in the Edo period, in a world where demons, humans, and gods exist together. 
The player controls Rasetsu Raki, a princess of the demon tribe who possesses great sealing powers and defeats the enemies by skillfully using various 'sword techniques' and 'barrier techniques' that destroy enemies

notes.title: Rasetsu Fumaden boss fight challenge!
notes.content:
Free demo of 《Rasetsu Fumaden》 is online today.
For everyone who loves this game to have a better experience, we decided to hold a boss fight challenge!

[h1]Challenge the twin foxes Kon and GIn, win a free game copy![/h1]

How to entry：
[olist]
[*]Record the boss fight of Kon and Gin
[*]Share your clip to anywhere we can access
[*]Copy the video link in this thread and leave a comment
[/olist]

We will check every clip and pick up the winners in these 3 conditions:
[list]
[*]Best time attack
[*]No damage taken
[*]randomly 3 players in this whole thread
[/list]

No level limit, no equipment limit.
Please share your equipment and status before the battle begins!

This event will close at 7/31 15:00 UTC
